react.description: React and TypeScript web frontends: components, styles, tests and their review agents.

nextjs.description: Next.js on top of the react layer: server-side data flow, upstream contracts, endpoints and services.

nextjs-app-router.description: Next.js App Router on top of the nextjs layer: where client components start, and the AGENTS.md of the app/ routes directory with what it holds.

java.description: Java and Kotlin services built with Maven or Gradle.

android.description: Android apps in Kotlin or Java built with Gradle and the Android Gradle Plugin.

software-development.description: Rules for code, the pull request template, the PR review workflow and the AGENTS.md skeleton of a software project; every stack requires it.

business-flows.description: Rules and a design skill for business flows on web and native clients.

browser.description: Browser automation tools (agent-browser, Playwright and Chrome DevTools MCP) installed in the user cache and registered for the project.

ci.description: Script .agents/ci/agent-ready-check.sh that runs the CI check; every CI provider calls it.

ci-generic.description: Only the CI script, for a pipeline of any provider.

ci-github.description: GitHub Actions workflow .github/workflows/agent-ready.yml that runs the CI script.

ci-gitlab.description: GitLab job .agents/ci/gitlab-ci.yml, included from a managed block of .gitlab-ci.yml.

ci-jenkins.description: Jenkins stage .agents/ci/jenkins-stage.groovy to copy into the Jenkinsfile, which is never edited.
